 Hon'Ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, J. 
Hon'Ble Arun Kumar, J.
1.

The petitioner is praying for quashing of recovery certificate dated 27.06.2024 issued by respondent no.2 for recovery of Rs.40,000/- imposed upon him as penalty vide order dated 08.08.2023 passed by ADM (Administration), Mathura in Case No.111 of 2029 registered under the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
2.
Learned counsel for the petitioner prays for withdrawal of the writ petition with liberty to the petitioner to challenge the order dated 08.08.2023 on basis of which, recovery is being made.
3. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of as withdrawn with liberty in terms of the prayer made.

(Arun Kumar,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.) September 8, 2025 Ankit.
